source.title: Leveraging Code and Documentation | Aikido
source.applicability: White-box penetration testing configuration using repository integration

passages.text: Connecting your repositories is the single most impactful step you can take. Instead of just poking at endpoints from the outside, the system analyzes the actual source code to understand how the application processes data.
